verdict.rationale: Opting out of vendor telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS fleet platform like Formant, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers configuring which robot data streams the agent uploads and how fast (formant-docs-37, formant-docs-31, formant-docs-42). Those settings control the customer's own device data ingestion, an adjacent feature, not an opt-out from Formant's own usage or analytics tracking. No documented telemetry opt-out appears in the pack.
